title: Built-in Request ID & Response-Time Middleware
description: Generates a unique request ID for every incoming request and adds a X-Response-Time header. This enables end‑to‑end tracing, simplifies debugging, and helps with performance monitoring without external dependencies.
testCases: When a request is received, `req.id` is a non‑empty string and the response includes an `X-Request-ID` header matching it
When the response finishes, the `X-Response-Time` header is present and its value is a positive number followed by 'ms'
acceptance: All unit tests pass, middleware can be toggled via `app.useRequestId()` and `app.useResponseTime()`, request IDs are unique per request, and response‑time header accurately reflects elapsed time (±5ms).
reason: Improves observability and debugging in production environments, a common requirement for micro‑service APIs, while keeping the framework zero‑dependency and lightweight.
